text:
Molly: Quick sync — need to lock the newsletter cadence + segmentation for the Nimble launch next week. Proposal: 3-email welcome series + weekly digest for 4 weeks. Draft segments below.
Raj: +1. Split by product interest tag ("evals" vs "infra") and company size (SMB / Mid / Enterprise). Recommend 3 core segments and a VIP list.
Sanjay: I can write short subject + preview variants. Are we personalizing by use-case token? first name + use-case works well.
Linh: Ops note — we need send windows for APAC/EU/NA. Suggest stagger: EU 09:30 local, APAC 09:30 local, NA 10:30 PT. Also enforce <5000/hr throttle while warming.
Olivia: Will design hero asset. Recommend using the benchmark chart as the hero CTA to webinar signup. Need copy length guidance (short headline + 1-line subhead).
Molly: Yes — hero = benchmark stat + one-line benefit. CTA: "See the benchmark & join the webinar" -> /webinar.
Raj: Nurture cadence (proposal): Day 0 welcome, Day 2 product story, Day 6 case study, Day 14 webinar invite + reminder Day 20. A/B the webinar invite subject.
Sanjay: Draft subject lines: 
- "Welcome to Redwood — quick setup & benchmarks"
- "How we cut inference cost by 3x (case study)"
- "See live demo + benchmarks — webinar invite"
Molly: Love the case-study angle for Day 6. Let's A/B test webinar invite with/without a teaser stat.
Linh: CRM rules: suppress recipients tagged "Onboarded" or "Enterprise-Sales". Also exclude emails bounced in last 90d. Braze list export should include suppression flags.
Olivia: Legal/Privacy QA — add the standard tracking/consent footer and a line about webinar recording availability. I'll share the footer snippet.
Raj: I'll build the segments in Braze and share a CSV for validation by EOD. Also setting up an A/B for subject variants and one for webinar CTA wording.
Sanjay: Copy drafts live here: https://docs.redwood/inbox/nimble-welcome (I'll add variants inline).
Molly: Small deliverables:
- Raj: segments + export by EOD (include suppression)
- Olivia: hero and 2 templates (long/short) by EOD tomorrow
- Sanjay: full copy for 4 sends by noon tomorrow
- Linh: confirm send windows + throttle config, verify IP warm status
LaunchBot: Campaign saved as draft: Marketing > Drafts (ID: MKT-9421).
Molly: Goal: hand off to design by 5pm tomorrow and to Ops for scheduling by Thursday. :rocket: 
Raj: noted — will ping once segments are in Braze and post the test plan.
Olivia: I'll put PNG + responsive mockups in Figma and tag @Molly @Sanjay when ready. :white_check_mark:
Molly: Thanks team — quick check-in tomorrow morning if anything blocks.
